build_source_model: build a source model from a dictionary config using Sources.from_dict and build_models
test_source_model_equality: test that two source models with the same config are equal and have the same hash
test_source_model_hash_different: test that source models with different standard sources have different hashes
test_source_model_hash_same_params: test that source models with different parameters but same standard source are equal
get_default_source_config: get the default source configuration dictionary from default_sources
